post.summary: Order a TransUnion credit report in CRS Standard Format
post.description: Pulls one TransUnion report and returns it in the CRS Standard Format (the same shape for all three bureaus). Send the person's fields at the root of the body (firstName, lastName, ssn, addresses ...), not inside a borrower object. Validation and bureau errors (no file, frozen file and so on) come back in errorMessages and responseAlertMessages. The RequestID response header is the report id for the PDF and re-fetch routes.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Your TransUnion credit report config name. An unknown or unassigned name still returns HTTP 200, with E1005 "User configuration not found" in errorMessages.

200.description: CRS Standard Format report. Check errorMessages.

401.description: Missing or expired JWT, or your account has no TransUnion access (ROLE_TU_CR).

429.description: Rate limited

post.summary: Fetch a stored TransUnion CRS Standard Format report
post.description: Send the same JSON body you sent when ordering the report, plus the order's `RequestID` response header in the path. Without the body the API returns 400 `CRS960 Missing request body`. Returns a report you already ordered, without a new bureau pull. Send the same request body as the original order.

post.summary: [Step 1]: CIC Criminal Report Request
post.description:
CIC’s Criminal Reports help lenders mitigate potential business risk by leveraging over a billion multi-jurisdictional criminal records that cover all 50 states + Washington D.C.. CIC’s Criminal Records Database utilizes fast, accurate, and FCRA-compliant heuristic name matching technology, to enhance accuracy when calculating risk.
This is a dynamic REST API endpoint. The HTTP response body returned is subject to change based on the customer's unique order configuration or due to API changes made by our data providers

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request can be admitted

post.summary: [Step 1]: CIC Eviction Report Request
post.description:
CIC’s Evictions Report leverages information from CIC’s nationwide eviction records database to help calculate and mitigate business risk. Eviction public records are updated daily from courts across the U.S. and adheres to the current and upcoming record regulations. Leveraging CIC’s unique matching methodology, lenders are able to query up to 30 addresses in a single inquiry, which helps reduce false positives and provides the risk mitigation information organizations need.
This is a dynamic REST API endpoint. The HTTP response body returned is subject to change based on the customer's unique order configuration or due to API changes made by our data providers

post.summary: Batch append step 1: get an upload URL for your CSV
post.description: Returns a pre-signed S3 URL. Upload the CSV to it with `PUT {uploadUrl}`, header `Content-Type: text/csv`, the raw file bytes as the body (not multipart/form-data), and no Authorization header. Then create the job with the timestamped file name: the part of `s3Key` after `/uploads/`, not `fileName`.

200.description: A page of your jobs, newest first

post.summary: Batch append step 2: create the append job
post.description: Starts a BATCH_APPEND job on the CSV you uploaded. The job runs in the background; poll `GET /jobs/{jobId}`. Batch append is not covered by the sandbox personas: the file goes to AccurateAppend.

get.summary: Batch append step 3: poll the job
get.description: Poll until `status` is `COMPLETED` or `FAILED` (PENDING → DISPATCHED → RUNNING → COMPLETED/FAILED). On FAILED, read `errorMessage`.

200.description: The job and its pipeline steps

get.summary: Batch append step 4: get the download URL
get.description: Only after the job is COMPLETED (otherwise 400). `records.downloadUrl` is a pre-signed S3 URL for the appended CSV; it expires (default 24 hours), so call this again for a fresh one.

post.summary: CRS Fraud Finder (AtData Fraud Prevention)
post.description: Email-centric fraud risk assessment powered by AtData. {config} is the user config query string; the standard config is 'fraud-finder'. Requires ROLE_ATDATA or ROLE_ADMIN. Identical requests are cached per user+config unless 'Cache-Control: no-cache' is sent.

400.description: CRS200 validation error (e.g. 'email: Email should be valid'), CRS102 config not found, or CRS777 AtData Service Error

401.description: Missing/invalid token or role not granted (CRS111 Access Denied)

post.summary: CRS Fraud Finder PDF
post.description: Generates a PDF report for a previous Fraud Finder request owned by the caller. No request body. Unknown or foreign request ids still return a PDF containing an error message.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: RequestID header value from the original /fraud-finder/{config} call

200.description: Successful AtData Fraud Prevention PDF Response

401.description: Missing/invalid token or role not granted

post.summary: TruValidate Identity Manager Verification Standalone Report
post.description:
TransUnion's TruValidate Identity Verification is a compliance and fraud detection solution that assess the risk associated with end user personal information. It checks input consumer data against multiple databases, analyzes the results, and alerts the subscriber to any data discrepancies as well as suspicious or known fraudulent data. This information may be provided as part of an application process and identity verification confirms the integrity and validity of that information. TruValidate provides support for a variety of services. These services include:
  • Identity Verification
  • Digital Verification
  • Knowledge-Based Verification
  • One time passcode Authentication

post.summary: PitchPoint Bankruptcies, Liens, and Judgments (FCRA) (Data Only)
post.description:
PitchPoint’s Application Data Verification (ADV) reports contain a series of customizable verifications focused on loan application, borrower, and property data, shielding lenders from fraud and undiscovered applicant misrepresentation. PitchPoint Civil Court Search provides robust reporting of national bankruptcy, lien, and judgment data, helping lenders detect unpaid and historical consumer debts.

  • Proprietary matching, filtering, and consolidation algorithms ensure maximum accuracy.
  • National data from municipal, county, state and federal courts.
  • Optional suppression of bankruptcy data.
  • Customizable court case age filtering.
  • Record research available.
